candidates.prompt: Write the short note with one Markdown image.

matchChecks.feedback: Add a Markdown image with an exclamation mark, a description in the brackets, and an address in the parentheses. Neither the description nor the address can be empty.

Example: `![Sunrise over the lake](https://example.com/images/lake-sunrise.jpg)`
